hero.headline: The Complete Finishing Package.
hero.subhead: Exterior wood cladding, interior millwork and architectural concrete for high end homes, run start to finish by one family crew led by a Red Seal carpenter.

intro.heading: Hand us the finishing and take it off your plate.
intro.text: Renova works two ways. For builders, we take on the whole finishing scope of a building, outside and in, so it runs as one job instead of five trades. For homeowners, we design and build kitchens, built ins and wood interiors directly. Either way, a partner is on site for the start, the key decisions and the finish, and the same crew carries it through. We also take on full renovations, kitchens, bathrooms and structural work. Ask us.

services.name: Complete Finishing Packages
paragraphs: Hand us the whole finishing scope of a building and take it off your plate. We run the cedar siding and soffits outside, then the doors, trim, cabinetry and millwork inside, with one crew and one standard from the first board to the last.
services.example: Cove Beach ADU in Sechelt. West Coast Turnkey gave us the entire guest house: mitered cedar siding outside, then doors, trim, cabinetry and countertops inside.
services.image_alt: Cove Beach ADU, Sechelt: mitered cedar siding corner meeting a window

extra_images.image_alt: Cove Beach ADU, Sechelt: finished cedar cladding

services.name: Exterior Wood Cladding
paragraphs: Mitered cedar siding with true waterfall corners, hemlock soffits and wood ceilings, detailed to last on the West Coast. No corner trim to hide behind: every joint is cut and fitted so the boards wrap the building cleanly.
services.example: Cove Beach and Lawrence Way, for West Coast Turnkey: mitered cedar rainscreen siding and hemlock soffits that run from inside to out.
services.image_alt: Mitered corner on cedar rainscreen siding at the Lawrence Way home, West Vancouver, boards wrapping the corner with no trim

extra_images.image_alt: Continuous hemlock soffit at the Cove Beach home in Sechelt

services.name: Interior Millwork and Finishing
paragraphs: Cabinetry, built ins, panelling, doors, trim and stairs, fitted to a fraction of a millimetre. It's the detail work that separates a good build from a photographed one.
We also build custom furniture and one off pieces for clients who want a hand built finish to match the rest of the home.
services.example: Lawrence Way in West Vancouver: open riser oak stairs with a glass railing under a hemlock plank ceiling.
services.image_alt: Open riser oak staircase with a glass railing under a hemlock plank soffit, Lawrence Way, West Vancouver

extra_images.image_alt: Custom slat wall millwork: vertical wood battens over a dark feature wall, wrapping onto the ceiling

services.name: Architectural Concrete and Formwork
paragraphs: Formed concrete stairs, retaining walls and planters, often the last pieces of a high end build. Good formwork is precise carpentry: you have to understand the forces of the concrete to get clean lines and true edges. Our team has run formwork crews for years, and it's the discipline Bill Jr. built his foreman career on.
services.example: A curved cast in place concrete staircase in Pemberton, formed and poured as one continuous sweep.
services.image_alt: Finished curved cast in place concrete stairwell wall

services.name: Design Build for Homeowners
paragraphs: Kitchens, built ins and wood interiors, designed in 3D with you and built by the same crew. Nicholas models the space in SketchUp so you can see every decision before anything is built, then carry it through drawings and permits. Projects from $25K.
services.example: Wende's Remodel in New Westminster: a design led kitchen with a marble waterfall island and herringbone floors.
services.image_alt: Wende's Remodel kitchen, New Westminster: navy cabinets and a marble waterfall island

cta.heading: Not sure which scope fits your project?
cta.text: Tell us what you're building and we'll walk you through the right scope and timeline.
